# Phase 3 — Tiferes Execution Contract

> Many apps, one pulse beneath; many scenes, one timed breath.
> On Awtsmoos.com the vessels differ, while a common light becomes their tether.

## Work graph
Discovery -> app inventory -> dependency trace -> runtime trace -> shared contract design -> whole-file implementation -> app adapters -> mobile UI integration -> showcase authoring -> static tests -> runtime tests -> browser tests -> delta audit -> final evidence.

## Planned artifacts
- `DISCOVERY.md`: movie-app inventory and import/runtime evidence.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`: chosen shared-core/backends/adapters contract and rejected alternatives.
- `REMAINING_WORK.md`: live closure ledger.
- `VERIFICATION.md`: exact commands, routes, runtime observations, failures, and fixes.
- Source modules: only after discovery identifies the real paths.

## Interface goals
- Project: metadata + duration + scenes + global assets/settings.
- Scene: time range + renderer mode + layers/entities + camera + transitions.
- Entity: typed node with transform, appearance, behavior, and tracks.
- Track: property target + keyframes/easing.
- AI command: normalized intent -> validated project/scene operations.
- Renderer adapter: mount, load scene, apply evaluated state, resize, destroy.
- App adapter: product-specific defaults, palette, templates, feature exposure.

## Showcase acceptance story
A three-minute authored project changes visual language several times: cinematic 3D establishing shots, character movement, 2D explanatory diagrams, animated text, data/infographic beats, particle transitions, close/wide/orbit camera changes, layered shapes, and a final composite scene. It must be reproducible from saved data and play from start to finish in the real app.

## Completion rule
When implementation seems done, re-read every touched file, compare planned vs actual, discover missing tests/docs/edge cases, fix remaining deltas, re-run browser verification, and only then close `REMAINING_WORK`.
